title: Exact codimension of a finitely supported base locus under etale pullback
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $X$ a smooth connected affine finite-type $k$-scheme of pure dimension $d$, and $\pi:T\to X$ an etale morphism. Let $S$ be a finite set of closed points, $U_0=X\setminus S$, $L$ an invertible module, $V$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space with a finite basis $b$, and $\psi:V\to\Gamma(X,L)$ an additive map. Suppose the restrictions of $\psi(b_i)$ generate $L|_{U_0}$. For each $w$ let $Z_w$ be the zero scheme of $\pi^*\psi(w)$ in $\pi^*L$. Every maximal irreducible closed subset $B$ of $\bigcap_w |Z_w|$ has codimension exactly $d$ in $T$. Codimension means coheight in the inclusion order on irreducible closed subsets. The scheme and morphism notions are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], invertibility and generation are [def-sc-invertible-module, def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], tensor pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback], zero schemes are [def-pc-zero-scheme], connectedness is [def-weil-connected-scheme], and pure dimension is [def-weil-pure-dimension]. Neither vanishing on S nor finiteness or connectedness of T is needed.

proof.text: Tensor pullback preserves zero schemes. The pulled-back common zero support is contained in the inverse image of S: a point over U0 has a nonvanishing basis section, by the stalk-span criterion and a local trivialization of the invertible module.

Smooth connected X is integral. Its affine coordinate domain has Krull dimension d by purity and the spectrum dimension theorem. At any closed point x in S, the finite-type domain dimension theorem gives coheight x = d.

Take the generic point t of B. Its image is a closed point of S by the support containment. Flat local quasi-finiteness of the etale map gives coheight t = coheight pi(t) = d. Transport through the generic-point order isomorphism. No finiteness of the base support upstairs is necessary.

theorem bertini_finiteCover_base_codimension
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsAffine X] [ConnectedSpace X]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : X.IsPureDimension d)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (π : T ⟶ X) [Etale π]
    (S : Finset X) (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ S, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (U₀ : X.Opens) (hU₀ : (U₀ : Set X) = (S : Set X)ᶜ)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (V : Type v) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (r : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k V) (ψ : V →+ Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hgen : Epi (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L).freeHomEquiv.symm
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection _
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (b i.down)))))))
 :
    letI : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L).IsInvertible :=
      Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible.of_iso
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction π)).leftAdjointUniq
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction π)).app L).symm
    ∀ B : TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds T,
      Maximal (fun Z : TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds T ↦
        (Z : Set T) ⊆ ⋂ w : V,
          ((Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback π).obj L)
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit π L (ψ w))).zeroLocus.support : Set T)) B →
      Order.coheight B = d
